info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Ktenasit Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to submit detailed information about the Ktenasit Pendant to the catalog. It facilitates seamless integration of new designs and enhancements, ensuring that the product offerings are up-to-date. Retailers, product managers, and designers typically leverage this API to enrich the catalog with valuable product data. By using this endpoint, businesses can efficiently manage their inventory and provide customers with comprehensive product details.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for the Ktenasit pendant. It accepts necessary data in the request body and processes it to store the pertinent information related to the Ktenasit pendant.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send details for a Ktenasit pendant operation. The data included in this request should conform to the specified schema for processing the pendant details.

CreateCatalogKtenasitPendantDetailReques.title: Ktenasit Pendant Details Request

ktenasit_pendant_id.description: The unique identifier for the Ktenasit pendant.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the pendant.

quantity.description: The quantity of Ktenasit pendants requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority or not.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Ktenasit pendant.

CreateCatalogKtenasitPendantDetailReques.description: Schema representing the request body for creating or updating Ktenasit pendant details.

CreateCatalogKtenasitPendantDetailRespon.title: Ktenasit Pendant Details Operations Response

status.description: Indicates the status of the operation.

recordId.description: Unique identifier for the record processed.

processedAt.description: Timestamp of when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: Number of records that matched the criteria.

CreateCatalogKtenasitPendantDetailRespon.description: Response schema for the successful operation of Ktenasit Pendant details. Contains the status, record ID, time of processing, and count of matches found.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource returned. This header provides information on the format of the response body, allowing the client to parse it correctly.

x-processing-time.description: Represents the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This can help clients understand the performance and efficiency of the API.
